newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Fitzwilton transfers 21 stores to Musgrave.
newsitem.headline: Fitzwilton transfers 21 stores to Musgrave.

text.p: Irish industrial holding group Fitzwilton Plc said on Thursday that it had agreed to transfer the business and business assets of 21 of its Northern Irish supermarkets to the privately owned Musgrave Group Limited.
Fitzwilton said in a statement that it had conditionally agreed to grant Musgrave subleases over the supermarkets, owned by its retail arm Wellworths, for a term of 25 years.

Fitzwilton and Musgrave will also enter into put and call options whereby Musgrave would acquire the property interests in the supermarkets in eight years time at a price of 55.1 million Irish pounds.
Musgrave owns the franchise to and services 166 SuperValu supermarkets and 235 Centra stores throughout Ireland and also operates a cash and carry business at eight locations in Ireland.
